g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: Google Cloud event-driven invoice processing with Eventarc, Cloud Functions and Document AI

g.title: None.None.Node.3
g.text: A supplier uploads an invoice PDF to Cloud Storage with a signed URL
The object-finalised event fires an Eventarc trigger
The function sends the PDF to the Document AI invoice parser
saves the supplier, lines and totals in Firestore
A BigQuery subscription writes every event to the finance dataset
A second trigger runs the validate function, which matches the invoice to its purchase order
Invoices over the limit start an approval workflow
which creates an approval task in the approvals app and waits for its callback
The finance team approves or rejects it
Approved invoices are posted to the ERP through Cloud NAT
Each night Cloud Scheduler runs a job that reconciles payments against the invoices
